capstone.name: Bislig City BPLS
capstone.problem: Business permit registration, renewal, and status tracking were handled manually, making the process slow for both city staff and business owners.
capstone.solution: Built a web-based Business Permit and Licensing System with an administrative dashboard, status tracking, and reporting tools.
capstone.result: Gives Bislig City's licensing office a centralized system for processing and monitoring permits instead of manual paperwork.

capstone.name: Bislig City Car Rental
capstone.problem: No online system existed for browsing vehicles, requesting bookings, or managing rental schedules.
capstone.solution: Built an online car rental management system covering vehicle listings, booking requests, scheduling, and admin monitoring.
capstone.result: Centralizes rental bookings and fleet monitoring in a single system for Bislig City.

capstone.name: ASCB Attendance & Payroll System
capstone.problem: Manual attendance tracking and payroll computation were time-consuming and prone to error.
capstone.solution: Built a system that automates employee time tracking, salary computation, and payroll reporting.
capstone.result: Reduces manual payroll work for Andres Soriano Colleges of Bislig staff.

capstone.name: SH Merchantile Inventory System
capstone.problem: Tracking stock levels, sales, and purchases manually made it difficult to stay on top of inventory.
capstone.solution: Built an inventory management system with real-time reporting for stock, sales, and purchases.
capstone.result: Gives the business real-time visibility into inventory movement instead of manual stock checks.

capstone.name: MIS Grading System
capstone.problem: Grade encoding and student performance tracking were done manually, slowing down faculty workflows.
capstone.solution: Built an academic grading system for efficient grade encoding and performance tracking.
capstone.result: Speeds up grade processing and reduces manual encoding errors.
